Asset acquisition adds the NovaCore brand, intellectual property, software, customer data, contracts, drone and mapping assets, and operating capabilities positioned for growth across Jamaica and the broader Caribbean

NovaCore intends to expand institutional programs with the University of the West Indies Global Campus and the University of Technology through its relationship with PlayJamaica Limited

MIAMI and KINGSTON, Jamaica, Oct. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- AIBotics, Inc. (OTCID: AIBT) ("AIBotics" or the "Company"), a global technology company building a platform around AI-enabled robotics, autonomous systems and intelligent automation, today announced the completion of its acquisition of the operating assets associated with NovaCore Labs ("NovaCore") from PlayJamaica Limited under an Asset Sale and Purchase Agreement.

The transaction provides AIBotics with a tangible operating platform to complete its expansion plans in Jamaica and the CARICOM. The Caribbean Economic Outlook 2026 projects a combined regional GDP of approximately US$420 billion with an average real GDP growth rate of 3.4% across major economies.

The acquired assets include 10 service robots, six commercial drones, three field generators, Google Street View mapping equipment and a dedicated mapping vehicle, together with the NovaCore brand and proprietary operating methodologies.

The acquisition expands AIBotics’ technology platform and operating presence in Jamaica while creating a foundation for broader growth across the CARICOM region. Through NovaCore, AIBotics intends to build on established capabilities in AI-enabled mapping and geospatial services, drone operations, automation, digital infrastructure, institutional technology programs and workforce development, with the goal of creating a scalable regional technology platform.

Ben Kaplan, Chief Executive Officer of AIBotics, commented, "NovaCore has established a presence in Jamaica through Google-related mapping initiatives, commercial technology deployments and relationships with leading academic and institutional organizations. Those capabilities can provide a practical platform for converting technology into recurring commercial activity rather than building a Caribbean operation from the ground up.

Following the acquisition, NovaCore intends to prioritize the expansion of business lines that present near-term revenue opportunities in Jamaica and the broader region. These initiatives include:

• AI, LiDAR and geospatial services: Building on NovaCore's mapping work, the business plans to expand into AI- and LiDAR-enabled asset management, surface classification and related geospatial services for public- and private-sector applications.

• Drone services: NovaCore intends to broaden commercial drone operations across selected public- and private-sector verticals, supported by acquired drone systems, field equipment, operating methodologies and drone-management software.

• Automation and robotics: The acquired asset package includes robotics equipment, operating methodologies, software and customer relationships that can support continued automation deployments across commercial environments.

• Education and workforce development: NovaCore intends to expand institutional programs with the University of the West Indies Global Campus and the University of Technology, including technical demonstrations, training, apprenticeship and internship initiatives designed to build local technical capacity.

• Technical infrastructure: NovaCore intends to expand its technical laboratory capabilities to support demonstrations, deployments, customer workflows and the development of a skilled regional workforce.

Under the Asset Sale and Purchase Agreement, AIBotics acquired the specified NovaCore assets from PlayJamaica Limited in exchange for 22,500 shares of AIBotics Series B Preferred Stock with an aggregate stated value of $225,000.

The agreement also provides for an earn-out of up to $3.0 million in additional Series B Preferred Stock over four years if the acquired business achieves specified cumulative gross-revenue milestones of $500,000, $1.5 million, $3.0 million and $5.0 million. Each revenue milestone corresponds to $750,000 of additional preferred-stock consideration.

Under the terms of the agreement, Gregory Moore is to lead the acquired business as President of the operating subsidiary. AIBotics and Moore are also to develop a budget targeting $1.0 million of capital deployment over a 12-month period.

Gregory Moore, co-founder of NovaCore Labs, commented, "This transaction gives NovaCore the opportunity to accelerate the work already underway in mapping, drones, automation, AI and institutional technology programs. Our focus now is execution - expanding services, deepening our technical capabilities, building revenue and creating solutions that can be deployed across Jamaica and the wider Caribbean."

Mr. Kaplan added, “NovaCore represents an important step in AIBotics’ evolution into a broader international technology platform. By expanding our presence in Jamaica and the Caribbean, we believe we can build meaningful businesses across AI, robotics, drones, mapping and automation while creating a foundation for long-term regional growth.”

NovaCore previously participated in Jamaica's Google Street View mapping initiative, providing a foundation for broader geospatial and digital-infrastructure applications. Management now intends to build on that work by incorporating AI and LiDAR technologies into services designed for asset management, surface classification, infrastructure analysis and other data-driven applications.

NovaCore also maintains relationships with the University of Technology and the University of the West Indies Global Campus. The Company intends to use those relationships to support training, demonstrations, workforce development and selected immersive-learning and simulation initiatives, while expanding the technical infrastructure available for client deployments and operational support.

AIBotics does not intend to identify public-sector agencies involved in active tender, evaluation or procurement processes unless and until disclosure is appropriate and authorized.

About AIBotics

AIBotics, Inc. is a global technology company building a platform around AI-enabled robotics, autonomous systems and intelligent automation. The Company focuses on applying advanced technologies to real-world environments through strategic partnerships, technology development and international market relationships. AIBotics seeks to identify, develop, implement and scale solutions that improve how machines operate, automate business processes and extend the practical application of artificial intelligence into the physical world. Through a scalable, partnership-driven model, AIBotics is building a diversified robotics and autonomous-systems platform designed to support commercial, industrial and other mission-driven applications across global markets. For more information on AIBotics, visit www.aibotics.ai.

NovaCore Labs is a Jamaica-based technology business focused on AI systems, automation, drone services, mapping and digital infrastructure. Its operating platform includes technology assets, software, customer relationships, geospatial capabilities and institutional partnerships that support public- and private-sector modernization initiatives across Jamaica and the Caribbean. For more information on NovaCore Labs, visit www.novacorelabs.com.

SHENZHEN, China, Oct. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- LexinFintech Holdings Ltd. (“Lexin” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: LX), a leading technology-empowered personal financial service enabler in China, today announced that it received a written notice (the “Notice”) from the Listing Qualifications Department of The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC (“Nasdaq”) on October 14, 2026 indicating that the Company is not in compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement under the Nasdaq Listing Rules (the “Listing Rules”). Based on the closing bid price of the Company’s listed securities from September 1, 2026 to October 13, 2026, the Company has not met the minimum bid price requirement set forth in Listing Rule 5450(a)(1) during that period. The Notice is only a notification of deficiency and has no immediate effect on the listing of the Company’s American Depositary Shares (“ADS”). The Company’s ADSs will continue to trade on the Nasdaq Global Select Market at this time. The Company’s receipt of the Notice does not impact the Company’s business, operations or reporting requirements with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. 

The Notice states that under Listing Rule 5810(c)(3)(A), the Company is provided with a period of 180 calendar days, or until April 12, 2027, to regain compliance with the Listing Rules, for which the closing bid price of the Company’s ADSs must meet or exceed $1.00 per ADS for at least ten consecutive business days unless Nasdaq exercises its discretion to extend this ten-day period. In the event the Company does not regain compliance by April 12, 2027, the Company may be eligible for an additional period to regain compliance or may face delisting.

The Company is evaluating options to regain compliance with Nasdaq’s continued listing requirements, including a potential adjustment of the ratio of its ADSs to Class A ordinary shares, and intends to take appropriate measures to timely regain compliance.

The Notice is a standard procedural communication under Nasdaq's listing rules and does not immediately impact the Company's business operations or SEC reporting status. While the Company will use reasonable efforts to regain compliance, there can be no assurance that the Company will ultimately be able to do so. In the event the Company is unable to regain compliance within the applicable period, Nasdaq will initiate delisting proceedings, and the Company will evaluate all available alternatives at that time.

NEW YORK, Oct. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Apollo Commercial Real Estate Finance, Inc. (the “Company”) (NYSE: ARI) today provided an update on its ongoing liquidation activities, including updates regarding the anticipated timing of delisting from the New York Stock Exchange (the “NYSE”) and the establishment of a liquidating trust for purposes of completing the wind-down process and dissolution of the Company in accordance with the Plan of Complete Liquidation and Dissolution (the “Plan”).

The Company has provided notice to the NYSE of its intention to voluntarily delist its shares of common stock (the “Shares”) from the NYSE. The Company expects to file a Form 25, or Notification of Removal from Listing, with the Securities and Exchange Commission (“SEC”) and the NYSE relating to the delisting of the Shares on or about October 27, 2026. The Company also expects that the last day of trading on the NYSE will be November 6, 2026. After delisting from the NYSE, the Company will transfer all of its remaining assets and liabilities to a statutory trust formed under the laws of the State of Maryland (the “Liquidating Trust”), deregister with the SEC, which the Company expects to occur on November 9, 2026, and terminate its existence by voluntary dissolution. The purpose of the Liquidating Trust is to wind up the Company’s affairs and liquidate the Company’s remaining assets, to preserve the value of such assets in connection with their orderly liquidation and, after satisfying or providing for the Company’s remaining liabilities, to distribute such assets or the proceeds thereof to the holders of the beneficial interests of the Liquidating Trust (the “Beneficial Interests”). After the transfer of the Company’s assets and liabilities to the Liquidating Trust, the Company intends to distribute the Beneficial Interests to the stockholders of the Company on a one-for-one basis.

Following the transfer of the Company’s assets and liabilities to the Liquidating Trust, subject to certain limited exceptions including transfer by will, intestate succession or operation of law, the Beneficial Interests will not be transferable, nor will holders of Beneficial Interests have authority or power to sell or in any other manner dispose of their Beneficial Interests. The Beneficial Interests will not trade on the NYSE or any other exchange. The rights of holders of Beneficial Interests in the Liquidating Trust will not be represented by any form of certificate or other instrument.

Based on guidance previously provided by the SEC in similar circumstances, assuming the Company terminates its existence as described above, the Company anticipates that the Liquidating Trust will be required to file only annual reports on Form 10-K (using the SEC file number of the Company) containing unaudited financial statements, as well as current reports on Form 8-K (also filed using the SEC file number of the Company).

The Company expects ACREFI Management, LLC, or one of its affiliates, to be retained as manager of the Liquidating Trust to oversee the day-to-day operations of the Liquidating Trust. The actual amount and timing of payment of any additional liquidating distribution(s) would be made by the board of trustees of the Liquidating Trust in its sole discretion.

Material U.S. Federal Income Tax Consequences
Information regarding the expected U.S. federal income tax consequences of any additional liquidating distributions, as well as the Plan, are summarized in the Company’s definitive proxy statement, filed with the SEC on August 24, 2026, for the special meeting of shareholders held on September 29, 2026, which is available free of charge through the website maintained by the SEC at http://www.sec.gov. However, the tax treatment described may vary depending on each shareholder’s particular situation.

About Apollo Commercial Real Estate Finance, Inc.
On September 29, 2026, the Company’s stockholders approved the liquidation and dissolution of the Company in accordance with the Plan. Prior to stockholder approval of the Plan, the Company operated as a real estate investment trust that primarily originated, acquired, invested in and managed performing commercial first mortgage loans, subordinate financings and other commercial real estate-related debt investments. The Company plans to sell all assets in an orderly fashion and return net proceeds from asset sales and cash on hand to stockholders, subject to payment of the Company’s liabilities and obligations and the creation of associated reserves. The Company is externally managed and advised by ACREFI Management, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company and an indirect subsidiary of Apollo Global Management, Inc., a high-growth, global alternative asset manager with approximately $1.05 trillion of assets under management as of June 30, 2026.

Key Terms

rsusfinancial
RSUs, or restricted stock units, are a form of company shares given to employees as part of their compensation. They are typically awarded with certain restrictions, such as a waiting period before they can be fully owned or sold, similar to earning a gift that becomes fully yours over time. For investors, RSUs can impact a company's stock offerings and reflect how much the company relies on stock-based incentives to attract and retain talent.
psusfinancial
PSUs are company shares promised to employees or executives that only become actual stock if the business hits specific performance targets over a set period. For investors, PSUs matter because they link pay to measurable outcomes — similar to a conditional bonus that converts into ownership — which can influence management decisions, dilution of shares, and signals about confidence in future results.
nasdaq rule 5635(c)(4)regulatory
NASDAQ Rule 5635(c)(4) is a listing standard that requires a company to obtain shareholder approval before issuing a substantial number of new shares or convertible securities in certain financing or insider-related transactions that would materially dilute existing holders. It matters to investors because the vote gives shareholders a check on deals that could significantly change ownership stakes or voting power—like a homeowners’ association approving a major renovation that affects the whole neighborhood’s value.

NEW YORK CITY, NY / ACCESS Newswire / October 16, 2026 / Emerging Growth Research ("EGR") today announced the publication of a company-sponsored Flash Report covering Newton Golf Company, Inc. (NASDAQ:NWTG), a technology-focused golf equipment company that develops and sells premium golf shafts, putters and related products.

The report examines Newton Golf's recently announced option to acquire the Pole Canyon project, a historic beryllium-tungsten property located in White Pine County, Nevada. It also discusses the Company's move into the U.S. critical minerals sector and the effect of the associated share issuance on EGR's earnings-per-share estimates.

Key Highlights

  • Pole Canyon Option - On September 24, 2026, Newton Golf announced it had completed a transaction granting it an option to acquire the Pole Canyon project, a historic beryllium-tungsten property in White Pine County, Nevada. The transaction represents the Company's entry into the U.S. critical minerals sector.
  • Consideration - In connection with the option, Newton Golf issued shares equal to 19.9% of its issued and outstanding common stock. Using EGR's previous estimate of shares outstanding at the end of Q3:26, the issuance is estimated at approximately 1.13 million shares.
  • Critical Minerals - Beryllium appears on the U.S. Geological Survey's 2025 List of Critical Minerals, while tungsten is included on the U.S. Department of Energy's 2023 Final Critical Materials List. Both materials have applications in aerospace, defense and advanced manufacturing.
  • Project Overview - Pole Canyon is a past-producing property comprising 16 unpatented lode claims across approximately 330 acres, about 50 miles southeast of Ely, Nevada. Historical materials describe a mineralized system extending for more than 4,000 feet and reportedly open along strike and at depth. They also cite a historical estimate of approximately 281,725 tons grading 0.75% beryllium oxide and 0.30% tungsten trioxide. Newton Golf has not independently verified these historical estimates.
  • Strategy - Newton Golf has stated that it does not plan to begin mining operations at this time. The Company instead intends to consider potential strategic agreements, with the option structure providing exposure to the project while limiting near-term operating and capital commitments.
  • Estimate Updates - EGR does not expect the transaction to affect the Company's revenue or operating income and has not changed its revenue forecasts. Reflecting the additional shares outstanding, EGR's FY:26 loss-per-share estimate narrows to $(1.23) from $(1.37), and its FY:27 estimate narrows to $(0.38) from $(0.42).

FORT COLLINS, Colo., Oct. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Woodward (NASDAQ: WWD), a global leader in aerospace and industrial energy control solutions, today announced the appointment of Paxton McVoy as Executive Vice President and Chief Information Officer (CIO), effective Oct. 19, 2026. He will join the company's Executive Leadership Team, reporting directly to Chief Executive Officer Chip Blankenship.

In this newly created role, McVoy will lead Woodward's global information technology organization and set the direction for the company’s digital strategy, including enterprise resource planning (ERP), data and analytics, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and technology-enabled business transformation.

McVoy joins Woodward from Veralto, where he was Senior Vice President and Chief Information Officer. Following Veralto's separation from Danaher, he led the new public company's global technology strategy and operations and helped build Veralto's technology organization after the company became independent. His responsibilities included enterprise technology, cybersecurity, data and AI, infrastructure, procurement, and oversight of the ERP portfolio across 13 operating companies. Earlier in his career, he held senior IT leadership roles at Medtronic, including Vice President and CIO for the company's Surgical Innovations business. He also previously was instrumental in leading Medtronic's transition from Oracle to SAP. 

"Paxton has a proven history of using technology to improve business performance and leading digital transformation across complex global organizations like ours. In this role he will help us to set the direction for how information technology will support our long-term growth strategy," said Chip Blankenship, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Woodward. "His experience shaping enterprise technology strategy, advancing AI capabilities, and building strong teams will help us strengthen Woodward's digital foundation in line with our efforts to serve customers and create shareholder value."

"I am looking forward to joining Woodward at an important point in the company's growth," said McVoy. "Woodward's focus on innovation, operational excellence, and creating value for customers and shareholders creates a real opportunity to use technology as a strategic advantage. I look forward to working with the leadership team and Woodward members around the world to help ensure the success of the company's digital transformation."

McVoy holds a Bachelor of Arts in Business from Otterbein University and an MBA from The Ohio State University.

For more than 25 years, the Central Texas Public Safety Commission has worked with first responders and community partners to identify and fund critical needs, including equipment, training, wellness programs and community initiatives that strengthen public safety.

“The Central Texas Public Safety Commission provides critical support for equipment, training and other needs that fall outside our normal operating budget,” said Austin Interim Fire Chief Tom Vocke. “Support from organizations like Bloom Energy helps supplement city resources and ensures our firefighters have what they need to stay safe and ready to respond.”

Austin Fire Department Station #3 opened in 1957 and serves the University of Texas and surrounding Central Austin neighborhoods. The station reopened in October 2023 following a renovation that rebuilt its apparatus bays and added dedicated spaces designed to improve firefighter health and safety while preserving the station’s original design.

Bloom will also be on the University of Texas campus Saturday during pregame festivities, where fans can take part in an interactive experience and learn more about Bloom's work, providing clean, reliable power for essential services and critical infrastructure across the country.

1st Summit Continues Earnings Progress as Strong Loan Growth and Strategic Investments Strengthen the Franchise

JOHNSTOWN, Pa.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--1st Summit Bancorp of Johnstown, Inc. (OTCID: FSMK) (the “Company”), parent company of 1st Summit Bank, today announced net income of $2.55 million for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, an increase of 2.3% compared to $2.49 million for the second quarter of 2026 and 49.7% compared to $1.70 million for the third quarter of 2025. Net income for the first nine months of 2026 totaled $7.3 million.

Third quarter results are a continuation of the progress established earlier in the year, with strong loan growth, further expansion in net interest margin, and stable credit quality. Net interest income increased 3.4% from the prior quarter, while noninterest expense increased just 0.6%, demonstrating continued discipline as the Company grows and invests in its future.

“Our third quarter results reflect the work that we have put into strengthening 1st Summit,” said Allison Johnson, Chief Executive Officer of 1st Summit Bancorp. “During the third quarter, we grew loans at a double-digit annualized rate, maintained stable credit quality, and kept quarterly expense growth below 1%. We are particularly encouraged by our ability to grow the loan portfolio while also maintaining the strong underwriting standards that have served this Bank well.”

She continued, “The progress is visible in our results, but it begins with our people and the relationships they build every day. Our team has remained focused on understanding customers’ needs, earning their business, and managing the Bank with discipline. We believe that this commitment will continue to help us build a stronger earnings foundation while creating room to invest in the customer experience and the future of the franchise.”

Balance Sheet Growth

Gross loans increased $24.2 million during the quarter to $941.5 million at September 30, 2026, representing annualized growth of 10.47%. Loans increased $60.2 million, or 9.1% annualized, from December 31, 2025. Quarterly loan growth was led by commercial real estate and construction, land and development lending.

Total deposits increased $13.9 million to $1.19 billion at September 30, 2026, representing annualized growth of 4.68%. Growth in interest-bearing demand deposits more than offset declines in time deposits and noninterest-bearing deposits during the third quarter of 2026. The loan-to-deposit ratio increased to 79.1% at September 30, 2026, compared to approximately 78.0% at June 30, 2026, as the Company continued to improve its earning asset mix.

Management continues to view loan growth and the development of lasting deposit relationships as closely connected priorities, and that growing those relationships supports the Bank’s lending capacity and strengthens the funding foundation needed to sustain its progress.

Total assets were $1.52 billion at September 30, 2026, compared to $1.53 billion at June 30, 2026. Shareholders’ equity totaled $99.5 million at September 30, 2026, compared to $109.9 million at June 30, 2026, primarily reflecting a $12.1 million increase in accumulated other comprehensive losses. Changes in accumulated other comprehensive income are recorded within shareholders’ equity rather than current-period net income.

Net Interest Margin and Profitability

Net interest income totaled $9.5 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, an increase of $316 thousand, or 3.4%, from the second quarter of 2026 and an increase of $1.5 million, or 19.1%, from the third quarter of 2025. Loan interest income increased $545 thousand from the prior quarter, more than offsetting lower investment income and higher total interest expense.

Net interest margin expanded to 2.63% for the third quarter of 2026, compared to 2.57% for the second quarter of 2026 and 2.28% for the third quarter of 2025. The improvement reflects continued progress in shifting the earning asset mix toward loans and strengthening the Company’s underlying earnings capacity.

With the current interest rate environment and liability mix, the pace of further margin expansion will depend increasingly on continued loan growth in the fourth quarter. Management remains focused on disciplined loan pricing and developing deposit relationships that support sustainable growth.

Profitability and operating efficiency remained solid during the third quarter of 2026:

  • Annualized return on average assets was 0.66%.
  • Annualized return on average equity was 9.47%.
  • The efficiency ratio remained essentially stable at 73.64%, compared to 73.61% for the second quarter of 2026.

Credit Quality Remains Stable

Credit quality remained stable during the third quarter of 2026 as the loan portfolio grew. Nonaccrual loans represented 0.32% of total loans at September 30, 2026. The allowance for credit losses totaled $7.3 million at September 30, 2026, or 0.78% of gross loans, and covered nonaccrual loans by approximately 2.39 times. The provision for credit losses was $200 thousand for the three months ended September 30, 2026, unchanged from the prior quarter.

Management believes this performance reinforces the value of consistent underwriting and active portfolio monitoring, and that preserving credit quality remains central to the Company’s approach to growth and its ability to translate new business into lasting shareholder value.

Noninterest Income and Expense

Noninterest income totaled $2.1 million for the third quarter of 2026, a decline of $251 thousand, or 10.9%, from the second quarter of 2026, primarily reflecting lower interchange and wealth management income. Compared to the third quarter of 2025, noninterest income increased 2.9%. No gains on sales of investment securities were recognized during the quarter.

Noninterest expense totaled $8.5 million for the third quarter of 2026, an increase of $51 thousand, or 0.6%, from the second quarter of 2026. Lower professional services and other operating expenses helped offset increases in salaries and benefits, data processing, and regulatory assessments and insurance.

The Company continues to manage everyday operating costs carefully while directing resources toward investments that improve service and support future growth.

Looking Forward

“We enter the final quarter of 2026 encouraged by what our team has accomplished and focused on closing out a strong year by delivering solid operating results,” Johnson concluded. “Our priorities remain clear: continue growing quality loans, build lasting deposit relationships, and preserve the discipline behind our progress. We are proud of how far we have come and remain committed to doing the work that creates long-term value for our shareholders, customers, and communities.”

About 1st Summit Bancorp of Johnstown, Inc.

1st Summit, through its wholly owned subsidiary, 1st Summit Bank (the “Bank”), is a community oriented financial institution that primarily focuses on relationship banking for both consumers and businesses. From 17 full-service community offices and one loan production office, the Bank provides a full array of personal and business banking solutions, investment management and trust services. Ahead of the Florida–South Carolina college football match-up, Bloom recognized Gainesville first responders who help keep the community safe

SAN JOSE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Bloom Energy (NYSE: BE) recognized Gainesville firefighters this week for work that begins long before an emergency call comes in.

Ahead of the Florida-South Carolina game, Bloom visited Gainesville Fire Rescue Station 1 and presented a $10,000 donation to Gainesville Professional Firefighters. The organization supports the firefighters and families behind Gainesville’s emergency response.

The visit was part of Bloom’s season-long partnership with ESPN Radio’s College Campus Tour, which is bringing Bloom to college towns across the country. NEW YORK, Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Fodere Critical Minerals Limited ("Fodere"), developer of a proprietary technology for recovering critical minerals from industrial residues and other unconventional feedstocks, today announced that its Board of Directors has elected Jeffry N. Quinn as Chief Executive Officer. Quinn will continue to serve as Chairman of the Board.

Quinn to lead as company deploys proprietary critical minerals recovery technology toward commercial-scale operations

Quinn assumes the role of CEO as Fodere moves from technology development and pilot-scale validation to commercial deployment, starting with a prototype plant planned for Mississippi.

Fodere was founded by Nicholas Cella, John Omitogun and Daniel Cousins, who took early university research and technical expertise, and developed it into the current proprietary process -- carrying it through laboratory, bench-scale and pilot plant campaigns on materials from four continents and completing a process design for a prototype plant. Quinn brings 40 years of experience in the global chemicals and mining industries. He previously served as Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Tronox (NYSE: TROX) and of Solutia Inc. (formerly NYSE: SOA), and earlier served as general counsel of three Fortune 500 companies.

He is also founder and Chairman of The Quinn Group LLC, a private investment and holding company focused on chemicals, mining, critical minerals and industrial businesses.

"I have spent my career building and transforming global chemicals and mining companies, and the industry-advancement potential of Fodere's proprietary technology is a standout," said Quinn. "The ability to recover titanium, vanadium and other critical minerals from materials historically treated as waste presents a compelling opportunity, while addressing the growing need for secure sources of critical minerals."

"Our focus now is on demonstrating the technology at production-representative scale and building the foundation for global deployment. The founders have taken this technology through the laboratory and the pilot plant phase, and I am honored to lead Fodere as we build a company around it."

"We are establishing a global platform based on our technology to recover critical minerals from waste streams that have historically gone untapped," said Nicholas Cella, co-founder of Fodere. "My co-founders and I are pleased to have Jeff lead Fodere into this next phase. His experience building and leading global companies is exactly what is required to make that platform a secure source of critical minerals supply."

LAS VEGAS, Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Hyperscale Data, Inc. (NYSE American: GPUS), an artificial intelligence ("AI") data center company ("Hyperscale Data" or the "Company"), today announced that its subsidiary, askROI, Inc. The Company and askROI are targeting a consummated Transaction by the second or third quarter of 2027, depending upon the type of transaction that the Company ultimately determines to pursue, and if the Transaction constitutes an RTO, the completion of the subsequent filing of a resale registration statement registering the shares of the current public company, which has not been identified, that the Company would receive in the RTO in consideration for the Company's sale of askROI to it in the first half of 2027, subject to the completion of necessary financial and regulatory requirements, as well as prevailing market conditions.

askROI is an AI technology company offering an all-in-one AI productivity, research, automation and content creation platform. Available through web and mobile applications, askROI provides access to leading AI models, more than 240 productivity tools, custom AI applications, enterprise knowledge management capabilities and generative AI technologies. The platform serves individuals, entrepreneurs, professionals and businesses seeking to leverage artificial intelligence to improve productivity, automate workflows and accelerate innovation. For more information, visit www.askROI.com.

The intended public listing represents another step in Hyperscale Data's broader strategy to unlock stockholder value by positioning its operating businesses to pursue independent growth opportunities and establish separate market valuations.

In connection with the preparation of the Transaction, Milton "Todd" Ault III will step down as Chief Executive Officer of askROI and askROI is expected to appoint Joseph Spaziano as Chief Executive Officer and Ryan Doucette as President. Mr. Spaziano, who currently serves as Chief Technology Officer of Hyperscale Data, as well as President and Chief Operating Officer of askROI, would step down from his role at Hyperscale Data to focus solely on askROI. Mr. Doucette currently serves as Head of Product at askROI. The Company currently anticipates, but cannot state with any certainty, that Messrs. Spaziano and Doucette would continue in these positions subsequent to any Transaction.

The planned leadership transition is intended to provide askROI with a dedicated management team focused on scaling its AI platform and positioning the company for independent operations.

Milton "Todd" Ault III, Founder and Executive Chairman of Hyperscale Data, commented: "We believe there is incredible value in askROI, which is currently not being recognized by the public markets while it is a subsidiary of Hyperscale Data. We also believe comparable AI technology companies often trade at substantially higher valuations, and we further believe that the stockholders of the Company would benefit from having askROI be a separate entity and have the ability to establish its own independent market value since we expect that such a separation could enhance the market capitalization of the Company by virtue of its ownership of a post-Transaction public entity. Finally, we expect this planned public listing can benefit Hyperscale Data stockholders, as well as future askROI shareholders, by providing greater transparency into the value of the business while creating a platform for future growth, access to capital and long-term shareholder value creation."

The Company expects to provide additional information regarding the transaction structure, corporate organization and listing timetable for the planned public listing of askROI at a later date. There can be no assurance that the proposed public listing will occur within the anticipated timeframe or at all.

The planned public listing of askROI is consistent with Hyperscale Data's broader strategy of evaluating opportunities to establish independent market valuations for its portfolio businesses. Management believes that separating certain operating businesses into independently valued enterprises could provide investors with greater transparency into the underlying assets and operations of Hyperscale Data. The Company intends to continue evaluating strategic alternatives for its subsidiaries and investments as it seeks to maximize long-term stockholder value.

SINGAPORE, Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- BUUU Group Limited (Nasdaq: BUUU) ("BUUU" or the "Company") today announced that its board of directors has approved a ten-for-one (10-for-1) forward split of the Company's ordinary shares, to be effected by subdividing each of the Company's issued and unissued Class A ordinary shares and Class B ordinary shares into ten shares of the same class (the "Share Subdivision"). The Share Subdivision is intended to make the Company's Class A ordinary shares more accessible to a broader base of investors and to enhance their trading liquidity. Subject to processing by Nasdaq, the Class A ordinary shares are expected to begin trading on a split-adjusted basis on the Nasdaq Capital Market at market open on October 26, 2026, under the Company's existing symbol "BUUU."

The Share Subdivision follows BUUU's completion on September 15, 2026 of its acquisition of a 60% equity interest in Brightray Science Inc., through which the Company has established industrialized AI data center delivery as its core growth business.

Details of the Share Subdivision

Key date. The Class A ordinary shares are expected to begin trading on a split-adjusted basis on the Nasdaq Capital Market at market open on October 26, 2026.

Ratio and mechanics. As a result of the Share Subdivision, each issued Class A ordinary share and each issued Class B ordinary share will be automatically subdivided into ten shares of the same class. As a result, each shareholder will hold ten shares of the relevant class for every share held immediately before the Share Subdivision (equivalent to nine additional shares for each share held). The Class A ordinary shares will continue to trade on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the symbol "BUUU." The new CUSIP number of the Class A ordinary shares following the Share Subdivision will be G1739L110.

Authorized and outstanding shares. In connection with the Share Subdivision, the maximum number of shares the Company is authorized to issue will increase proportionately from 500,000,000 shares of no par value, divided into 250,000,000 Class A ordinary shares and 250,000,000 Class B ordinary shares, to 5,000,000,000 shares of no par value, divided into 2,500,000,000 Class A ordinary shares and 2,500,000,000 Class B ordinary shares.

Rights and ownership unchanged. The rights and restrictions attaching to each class of shares will remain unchanged, including the voting rights of one vote per Class A ordinary share and twenty votes per Class B ordinary share, and all shares of each class resulting from the Share Subdivision will rank pari passu in all respects with each other. The Share Subdivision will not change any shareholder's percentage ownership interest or voting power in the Company. No fractional shares will result from the Share Subdivision.

No action required unless you hold physical certificates. No action is required by shareholders. Shareholders who hold Class A ordinary shares through a bank, broker or other nominee will have their positions automatically adjusted to reflect the Share Subdivision, subject to their nominee's particular processes. The Company's transfer agent, VStock Transfer, LLC ("VStock"), will update the holdings of registered shareholders in book-entry form. Registered shareholders holding share certificates will be asked to deliver a letter of transmittal to VStock to surrender their certificates to VStock in exchange for the right to receive post-Share Subdivision ordinary shares in electronic, book-entry form.

Outstanding securities. Proportionate adjustments will be made, to the extent provided by their respective terms, to the number of Class A ordinary shares issuable upon the exercise, conversion or settlement of, and to the exercise price or other per-share terms of, the Company's outstanding warrants and other securities exercisable for, convertible into or settleable in Class A ordinary shares.

Approval. The Share Subdivision was approved by the Company's board of directors on September 28, 2026.

The Company will furnish a copy of this press release to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC") on Form 6-K.

BERLIN, MA / ACCESS Newswire / October 16, 2026 / Calvin B. Taylor Bankshares, Inc. (OTCQX:TYCB), parent company of Calvin B. Taylor Bank, announced that the Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.42 per share for the third quarter of 2026. This dividend is payable on November 5, 2026, to stockholders of record as of the close of business on October 26, 2026.

"The Bank's continued strong financial performance and disciplined capital management have enabled us to increase our regular cash dividend once again, resulting in a 9.0% increase in year-to-date dividends in 2026 versus the same period last year," stated M. Dean Lewis, Chief Executive Officer and President. "We remain focused on creating long-term stockholder value through disciplined capital management, as demonstrated by our long-standing history of sustainable cash dividend growth and strategic stock repurchases."
